about.title: About Benton Pro Lighting
text: Benton Pro Lighting is a trusted electrician serving Pasadena, Texas, providing reliable, code-compliant solutions for both residential and commercial clients. We specialize in full-service electrical work, structured data cabling, and generator installations—ensuring your home or business stays powered, connected, and protected.

Beyond our core offerings, we also provide landscape lighting, outdoor audio systems, and seasonal holiday lighting décor. Whether it’s essential electrical infrastructure or adding a touch of ambiance to your outdoor spaces, Benton Pro Lighting delivers quality workmanship, safety, and dependable service you can trust.

Looking for reliable electrical services in Pasadena, Texas? Benton Pro Lighting specializes in electrical work, structured data cabling, and generator installations. We also offer landscape lighting, outdoor audio setups, and holiday lighting decor for your home or business. Reach out today for expert solutions!
